topography.project_purpose: Basis Trading. Structurally: 17 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 2 ERC20 tokens; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin-upgradeable.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 5 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, ownableupgradeable, contextupgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin-upgradeable.
